companions.name: Pip the Squire
banter: Did you SEE that?! ...Sorry. Sorry!
Left flank! No — right! I mean — got it!
One day they'll sing about this. Me. Us!
My sword arm's tired. My other sword arm isn't.

companions.name: Hedge-Witch Wren
banter: Moss and patience, Captain. Mostly moss.
That wound says rude things. Hold still.
The clouds favor the stubborn today.
Drink this. Don't ask. Drink.

companions.name: Shieldbearer Bruma
banter: Behind me.
They break on me or not at all.
Hm.
Still standing. You're welcome.

companions.name: Knives Tess
banter: You owe me for that one.
Seventh knife today. I'm counting.
Try to bleed somewhere I can see.
Debts paid in steel. Always.

companions.name: Chaplain Ode
banter: Rise. The sermon isn't finished.
Blessed are the heavily armored.
Your suffering has been noted. And healed.
Kneel for triage. Stand for war.
